title: ComCare income benchmarks and inflation-linked assistance
asked: Mr Cai Yinzhou asked whether income eligibility thresholds for financial assistance schemes will be reviewed given cost-of-living pressures, and whether ComCare short-to-medium-term assistance amounts are benchmarked against core inflation.
response: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim said MSF reviews the ComCare per capita household income benchmark regularly. The current benchmark of $800 and below is indicative, not a qualifying criterion, and families above it with valid needs may still get ComCare case by case. ComCare assistance rates are regularly adjusted, and the Short-to-Medium-Term assistance quantum accounts for projected inflation. He also cited the Assurance Package and said MSF is monitoring the situation and prepared to make adjustments.

key_points.point: MSF reviews the ComCare per capita household income benchmark regularly.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
key_points.quote: the Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF) reviews the ComCare per capita household income benchmark regularly.

key_points.point: The $800-and-below gross monthly per capita household income benchmark is indicative, not a qualifying criterion.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
key_points.quote: The current gross monthly per capita household income benchmark of $800 and below is an indicative benchmark and not a qualifying criterion.

key_points.point: Families above the benchmark with valid needs may still be assisted with ComCare case by case.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
key_points.quote: Families who are above the benchmark but have valid needs may still be assisted with ComCare on a case-by-case basis.

key_points.point: ComCare assistance rates are regularly adjusted.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
key_points.quote: The ComCare assistance rates are also regularly adjusted to ensure adequate support.

key_points.point: The ComCare Short-to-Medium-Term assistance quantum accounts for projected inflation.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
key_points.quote: The ComCare Short-to-Medium-Term assistance quantum accounts for projected inflation.

key_points.point: Other cost-of-living support includes the Assurance Package with cash, U-Save, service and conservancy charge rebates, and CDC vouchers.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
key_points.quote: there is also support in other forms, such as the Assurance Package, which has been enhanced with additional cash, U-Save, service and conservancy charge rebates, and Community Development Council (CDC) vouchers over the years.

key_points.point: MSF is monitoring how low-income families are impacted by current economic conditions.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
key_points.quote: MSF is monitoring the situation closely on how the low-income families are being impacted by the current economic situations and conditions.

key_points.point: MSF is prepared to make adjustments as needed.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
key_points.quote: We are prepared to make adjustments as needed.

key_points.point: Reviews consider expenditure for basic living needs, projected inflation, and views from social service professionals.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
key_points.quote: Our reviews take into consideration data on expenditure for basic living needs, projected inflation and also views from social service professionals who work closely with our low-income families.

key_points.point: The benchmark does not automatically qualify or disqualify a household from ComCare.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
key_points.quote: The benchmark itself is not a criterion that automatically qualifies or disqualifies a household from ComCare.

key_points.point: ComCare assistance rates were reviewed a year ago and inflation assumptions were factored in.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
key_points.quote: the ComCare assistance rates were reviewed only a year ago and MSF had already factored in some inflation assumptions so that the threshold is still within the buffer.

key_points.point: $500 CDC vouchers will be brought forward to June 2026.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
key_points.quote: CDC vouchers of $500 will be brought forward to June 2026.

key_points.point: The Cost-of-Living Special Payment was enhanced, with eligible Singaporeans receiving up to $400 to $600 in September 2026.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
key_points.quote: The Cost-of-Living Special Payment has also been enhanced, and eligible Singaporeans can receive up to $400 to $600 in September 2026.

key_points.point: ComLink+ families are eligible for enhanced payout measures announced in this year's Budget and Committee of Supply.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
key_points.quote: For families who are on ComLink+, they are also eligible for the enhanced payout measures that have already been announced in this year's Budget and Committee of Supply.

left_open: Whether income eligibility thresholds for financial assistance schemes beyond ComCare will be reviewed.
Whether ComCare Short-to-Medium-Term assistance quantum is periodically benchmarked specifically against core inflation.
Whether an immediate stopgap disbursement for ComCare recipients, especially those with young children, will be considered.
supplementary: Immediate stopgap cash support for ComCare recipients, especially families with young children.
